not in this pilot's instruction booklet
quantity: fuel capacity, total in three tanks
fuel mass, total in three tanks
start: oil pressure min after start
engine warm: inlet oil temperature min
engine warm: outlet oil temperature min
ground run at rated power: boost (Pk)
ground run at rated power: rpm
ground run: outlet oil temperature range

take-off prohibited: outlet oil temperature outside

rows.until: inlet oil 25 C or outlet oil 50 C, then 1500 rpm
